request.style: English, deep male voice, solo with choir, acoustic guitar, cello, drums, bass, melancholic, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Solomon's son took the crown of the south
Forty-one years he stood at the gate
Seventeen years in the chosen city
His mother Naamah from Ammon's state
The people turned from the Lord's command
They sinned and provoked His jealousy
Building high places on every hill
Idols under every green tree

[Chorus]
He carried off the treasures of the Lord
Gold shields from the palace hall
Rehoboam made shields of bronze
For the guard to stand and call

[Verse]
In the fifth year the Egypt king came
Shishak marched against Jerusalem
He took the gold from the house of God
And from the royal palace as well
Nothing was left in the holy place
Except the bronze that could not be kept
He gave them to the commanders of the guard
To watch at the palace gate

[Chorus]
He carried off the treasures of the Lord
Gold shields from the palace hall
Rehoboam made shields of bronze
For the guard to stand and call

[Bridge]
War between Rehoboam and Jeroboam
Continual conflict in the land
He lay down with his fathers at last
Buried in the City of David's hand
Abijam stood up to take the throne
The story remains as it was planned

[Outro]
Bronze shields for the guard to keep
In the house of the Lord they sleep
